app.name: MCN
app.subtitle: Maine Coon Network
app.tagline: Quiet strength never rushes. The Vault is filling.
onboarding.welcome: The Guardians have been expecting someone.
onboarding.intro: Enter the Vault, take a name, and return each day. Your place in the Kingdom grows with every visit.
onboarding.noWallet: No wallet, no payment, no email required.
home.playSub: About 30 seconds. Earn XP and Vault Shards.
home.vaultFridaySub: The Vault is louder today. Guardians gather.
rank.maxed: You have reached the highest rank a player can hold.
rank.allSubtitle: Every rank changes your chest, your chambers and your standing.
chest.title: Daily Chest
chest.alreadyOpened: You have already opened today's chest.
chest.oddsIntro: Every chest gives at least one guaranteed reward. These are the real weights used by the server.
chest.evolves: Rank up and this chest is permanently replaced by a better one.
streak.title: Streak
streak.shieldExplain: A Shield absorbs one missed day so a single absence never erases your streak.
streak.shieldUsed: A Streak Shield protected your streak.
streak.broken: Your streak restarted. Nothing you earned was lost.
missions.title: Missions
missions.empty: No missions right now. Come back tomorrow.
game.title: Crystal Resonance
game.howTo: Tap the crystal as the ring closes on it. Tighter timing scores more. Chain hits to build a combo. Gold crystals are worth double.
game.reduced: Repeat runs today pay reduced rewards. Your score still counts on the leaderboard.
game.rateLimited: You have played a lot in the last hour. Take a breath and come back shortly.
game.rejected: That run could not be validated.
explore.title: The Vault
explore.subtitle: Six chambers. You have seen {seen} of them.
leaderboard.title: Leaderboards
leaderboard.empty: No Guardians ranked yet. Be the first.
profile.title: Profile
profile.emptyCollection: Nothing here yet. Open chests and play runs.
profile.signOutHint: Your progress stays on the account. Signing back in on this device is not possible in V1, so only do this if you mean it.
profile.forgeSoon: The Forge and the Armory open in the next chapter.
wallet.title: MCN Wallet
wallet.disabled: Wallet connection arrives in a later chapter.
wallet.disabledBody: MCN The Vault is a game first. Wallet linking, MCN balance and any future rewards are built into the architecture but stay switched off until they are ready and reviewed.
rankup.title: The Vault recognizes you.
